name: ccx
description: ccx - claudecodex: sync task memory between Codex and Claude Code. Import a Claude Code session into this thread, keep both in sync, or hand this thread to Claude.

interface.shortDescription: Sync task memory between Codex and Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Pairs a Claude Code session with a Codex thread so you can keep working on the same task in either app: the other side's new progress is brought into the conversation you are in. Not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
